about: canvas-scenes's application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk12-bounce-keeps-heading
mutants.to: VX: if bounceX { b.VX } else { b.VX }
mutants.rule: A bounce turns the ball's velocity round (case tour: dot 2 off the left edge; the law only sees the size).

mutants.name: fk12-ball-leaves-the-canvas
mutants.rule: A ball stays a radius inside the canvas (law BallsStayInBounds).

mutants.name: fk12-drop-reuses-the-stream
mutants.to: NextID: f.NextID + 1, Seed: if len(Palette) > 0 { f.Seed } else { s4 }}
mutants.rule: Each drop draws the next numbers (law DropsDrawFromTheStream).

mutants.name: fk12-clear-renumbers
mutants.rule: Clear keeps the numbering (law DropsDrawFromTheStream; the screen shows no ball's number).

mutants.name: fk12-balls-frame-in-tenths
mutants.rule: A ball moves its velocity per second (case tour: frame 16 x10).

mutants.name: fk12-unit-past-one
mutants.rule: A draw is inside its range (law DropsDrawFromTheStream: radius and speed).

mutants.name: fk12-trail-one-too-long
mutants.rule: A trail is at most 36 points (law AFrameKeepsTheCrowd).

mutants.name: fk12-four-births-a-frame
mutants.rule: A frame adds at most 3 particles (law AFrameKeepsTheCrowd).

mutants.name: fk12-particles-never-leave
mutants.rule: A particle past the settling band dies (case tour: six seconds of frames; the law's scenes are too short to reach the band).

mutants.name: fk12-particles-never-age
mutants.rule: A particle ages and dies at the end of its life (case tour: frame 50 x120).

mutants.name: fk12-long-frame-uncapped
mutants.rule: A frame counts at most 50 ms (case tour: frame 1000).

mutants.name: fk12-burst-half-circle
mutants.rule: A burst heads out evenly round the whole circle (law ABurstFansOut).

mutants.name: fk12-pointer-swirls-nothing
mutants.rule: The pointer swirls the field near it (case tour: move 480 300).

mutants.name: fk12-reset-keeps-pointer
mutants.rule: Reset forgets the pointer (case tour: clear in the flow).

mutants.name: fk12-slider-rounds-down
mutants.rule: A slider takes the nearest step (law SlidersKeepTheirSteps).

mutants.name: fk12-boost-never-fades
mutants.rule: A burst particle turns from its heading to the field as its boost fades (case tour: press 480 300 then frames).

mutants.name: fk12-noise-hash
mutants.rule: The noise is upstream's hash (case tour: the heads' centre).

mutants.name: fk12-paused-flow-moves
mutants.rule: A paused scene ignores frames (law PausedTickIsIdentity).

mutants.name: fk12-switch-to-paused-balls
mutants.rule: A switch starts the other scene running (law ActsReachTheShownScene).

mutants.name: fk12-switch-restarts-the-stream
mutants.rule: The stream passes on through a switch (law SeedReplays).

mutants.name: fk12b-frame-is-time-since-start
mutants.rule: A frame steps the scene by the time since the frame before, not since the host began (law FramesAreTheTimeBetween; cases).

mutants.name: fk12b-paused-frames-count
mutants.rule: A paused scene ignores frames (law APauseStopsTheCount).

mutants.name: fk12b-pause-keeps-the-count
mutants.from: if Running(next) { Program{Scene: next, Last: p.Last} } else { Program{Scene: next, Last: option.None} }
mutants.to: if Running(next) { Program{Scene: next, Last: p.Last} } else { Program{Scene: next, Last: p.Last} }
mutants.rule: A pause stops the count, so the first frame after play moves nothing (law APauseStopsTheCount; case tour: frame 16 x2 after play).

mutants.name: fk12b-no-frames-asked
mutants.rule: The screen asks for frames while its scene runs, and only then (cases: frames wanted, none).

mutants.name: fk12b-pause-never-plays
mutants.rule: Pause turns to Play while the balls stop (case scenes: click Pause, then click Play).

mutants.name: fk12b-pointer-moves-nothing
mutants.from:
case ui.Moved, ui.Drag:
			option.Some[app.Signal]{Value: app.On{Signal: scene.Moved{X: e.X, Y: e.Y}}}
mutants.rule: A move over the flow's canvas points the field (case tour: move 480 300, the pointer ring).

mutants.name: fk12b-slider-half-track
mutants.rule: A press on a slider's track asks for the value where it was pressed (case scenes: strength 1.62 reads 1.60).

mutants.name: fk12b-fixed-drops-a-zero
mutants.rule: A slider shows its value to two places, as toFixed(2) (case scenes: scale 1.05).

mutants.name: fk12b-balls-one-colour
mutants.rule: A ball is painted in its own colour (cases: dot colours).

mutants.name: fk12b-head-never-fades
mutants.rule: A particle's head fades in and out with its life (case tour: heads at alpha 0 on the first screen).

mutants.name: fk12b-hsla-green-is-blue
mutants.from: let g = channel(8.0, h, lig, c)
mutants.to: let g = channel(4.0, h, lig, c)
mutants.rule: A colour is CSS's hsla worked out to bytes (cases: dot colours).

mutants.name: fk12b-trail-stroked-once
mutants.rule: A trail is stroked twice, its glow then its core (case tour: strokes twice the trails).

mutants.name: fk12b-vignette-three-strips
mutants.rule: The vignette is four steps of four strips (cases: 20 fills on an empty flow).
